principles.name: Latent Task Truth
principles.text: Any task-relevant truth may be latent; latent truth is not restricted to operational HOW or WHEN.

principles.name: Shared Epistemic Boundary
principles.text: Anything hidden from Base is also hidden from Learner. Learner receives no privileged policy, Oracle answer, evaluator truth, or private backend semantics.

principles.name: Experience Recoverability
principles.text: Latent truth must be recoverable in principle from learner-visible interaction history; no fixed positive/negative/boundary evidence shape is required.

principles.name: Empirical Headroom
principles.text: Learning headroom must be measured by frozen rollout calibration; tasks cannot be tuned after observing Base outcomes to manufacture desired bad cases.
